name: Mirror
description:
Mirror turns Claude into a psychological astrologer. Instead of listing transits and placements like a textbook, it conducts a multi-phase interactive reading — gathering birth data, calculating natal charts and transits via parallel agents,
synthesizing everything into one narrative, delivering a concise portrait, then shifting into real conversation using the OARS therapeutic framework. It handles sect-aware interpretation, dispositor trees, three-layer Chiron analysis, shadow
material, and honest temporal framing with real dates. The skill is designed to make people feel genuinely seen, not generically described.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `mirror` (Deep astrological reading as self-confrontation).

Installs with `claude plugin install mirror@claude-community` from `AvyanshKatiyar/mirror`.

A Claude Code plugin that transforms AI astrology from generic horoscope columns into genuine psychological mirrors. Mirror conducts multi-phase readings that blend natal chart analysis, real-time transits, and conversational psychology to create the "yes, this is me" feeling that most AI readings miss.
